runs.question: Which four functions make up the NIST AI RMF Core, and which one is described as cross-cutting?

answer.text: The AI RMF Core has four functions: GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE. The Core is composed of four functions: GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE. GOVERN is the function described as cross-cutting. The framework says it is meant to inform the other three and be built into them, and that risk management should run continuously across the AI system lifecycle (Governance is designed to be a cross-cutting function to inform and be infused throughout the other three functions.).
